name: Birch Plywood (Koivuvaneri)
safety_note: Laser-safe exterior/interior glue only. Ensure flat bed contact to prevent smoke traps.

name: Acrylic / PMMA (Cast & Extruded)
safety_note: Cast acrylic etches frosted white; extruded cuts cleaner. Keep air extraction ON at all times.

name: Solid Hardwood / Softwood
safety_note: Density varies with grain. Watch for resinous pockets that can catch fire during slow passes.

name: Veg-Tanned Leather
safety_note: MUST be vegetable-tanned. Chrome-tanned leather releases toxic chromium gases.

name: Corrugated Cardboard / MDF Board
safety_note: High risk of flare-up! Never leave machine unattended during fast vector passes.

name: Anodised / Coated Aluminium
safety_note: CO2 laser cannot cut raw metal. Surface etching bleaches the oxide layer or vaporises coating.
